sources.finding: Nearest-school network accessibility, not actual attended-school journeys; modeled walking speed5.4km/h. Age14–17 demand estimated from broad age bands rather than observed age-specific enrollment.
sources.admission_reason: Author explicitly states student travel behaviour was not captured; four-district historical modeled proximity cannot replace city actual one-way duration.

sources.sample_scope: Convenience sample at one public Anatolian high school in an unnamed central European-side Istanbul district
sources.finding: Questionnaire measures eight out-of-school activities plus other; no home-to-school duration item. Overall age range does not supply age14vs18 outcomes.
sources.admission_reason: No commute measure, no representative city or district comparison; behavior is not elicited importance weights.
